snippet.title: Matchbox CATERPILLAR Big Dirt Movers - City Zone
snippet.description:
A old building must be demolished in order to make room for a fair. Use the wrecking ball to destroy the building and use the excavator to pick up the pieces to be loaded into the dump truck. The dump truck then takes the pieces to the junkyard. Some vehicles must also be removed so don't forget about those.

BTW, I do have a little problems getting used to the controls since it's been almost ten years since I've played this game.
